facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/plymouth/park/hillview-recreation-area/Activity/Camping ('A modern shower house with restrooms'; Bur Oak 'A vault toilet ... as well as a communal water hydrant'), read 2026-11-02

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/plymouth/park/hillview-recreation-area/Activity/Camping ('All campsites are first come first served, with the exception of the last camping weekend when Halloween at Hillview takes over the park. Sites can be reserved for that weekend on the Tuesday after Labor Day.'; 'not more than 14 days during a 21 day period'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Bur Oak $20 a day ($120 a week), Deer Ridge $25 ($150 a week), weekly paid in full on arrival.

note: Plymouth County Conservation Board HQ park W of Hinton. Deer Ridge has the hookups and is reached from Wren Road; Bur Oak is off the C60 entrance, near the elk enclosure. Beaver Creek is tent-only. Campers get free Friday and Saturday nights on the Halloween weekend in exchange for handing out candy. --Claude
summary: Confirmed Deer Ridge 27 water/50A, Bur Oak 18 electric, $20-25, May 1-Oct 14; reservable corrected to false (FCFS except one October weekend by phone), sites count added, note trimmed.
flags: Booking changed: stored reservable true/some_sites came from a single event weekend. The county says all sites are first-come; the Halloween weekend is by phone at 712-947-4270.

Fit, base rate: fees base $20 is Bur Oak, whose paved sites are 'roughly 40' x 10'' and 'good for small campers, but larger units will have a hard time': no stated limit under 23 ft and 40 ft of pad holds EKKO, so it counts. Quote kept in sites.note.

Not waterfront holds: Deer Ridge is one row on an upland strip, about 240 m from the 3-acre pond (county's 'A 3 acre pond'; under 5 acres, so a pond) across a field, scaled from imagery. Bur Oak not located on imagery, pads hidden.

Split: Deer Ridge has its own entrance (Wren Road) and Bur Oak the C60 entrance, but I could not measure Bur Oak's pads; imagery suggests they are under about 1 km apart. Not proposed as a split. Pin 42.64180,-96.32370 is about 135 m south of the Deer Ridge row centre (42.6430,-96.3243): fine.
